next.reason: 1985 relative FD allows BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD, LABEL RECORD(S) STANDARD/OMITTED, VALUE OF implementor-name-1 and DATA RECORD(S). §2023:13.4.5.2 Format 2 'relative-or-indexed' (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR7) keeps BLOCK CONTAINS (§2023:13.18.10.2) and the record-clause (§2023:13.18.43.2, BYTES a synonym per §2023:13.18.43.3 SR2) but has no LABEL, VALUE OF or DATA RECORDS clause anywhere in the standard, so a 1985 relative FD using them is refused. EXTERNAL/GLOBAL are not new (1985 X.4.2.2). CHANGED (stricter).
